milestones.details: Experimental integer scope and full-replacement boundary are explicit.
Dependency-ordered roadmap preserved; implementation evidence is separate.
All legacy source/foreign/generated files inventoried; entrypoint transitive closure still required.

Strict canonical artifacts and parent/reflection checks implemented for the integer profile; protected compatibility/evidence admission unfinished.
Typed/effect-checked integer KIR, independent evaluator and bounded owned host plans implemented; declarative implementation refinement unfinished.

Live checked Pulse observer and closed linear U32/ref exporter implemented; three actual source entrypoints execute through core/C/SPIR-T/Vulkan. Static shapes, arrays, loops, dependency proof closure, per-lane lifting and O1/O2 remain unfinished.
Core and C execute owned KIR plans and three actual source-derived kernels. General source host-plan export, async/native host semantics and an independent second source frontend remain unfinished.

Independent compiler/runtime match complete word ABI and format; broader capability/evidence composition unfinished.
Installer and integration verify unchanged core sources; full immutable release/additional-extension admission unfinished.
Pinned direct SPIR-T construction, diagnostics and final validation implemented; broad feasibility/refinement qualification unfinished.
Actual checked linear U32/ref source and independent KIR fixtures execute through direct SPIR-T on CPU Vulkan. Source refinement and physical GPU qualification remain unfinished.
Pretested/nested loops and condition effects tested; full convergence, barrier, pointer and trace refinement unfinished.

Vulkan feature/limit checks, barriers, fence visibility and retained cleanup implemented; complete deployment/fault qualification missing.
Digests bind parent, target and tools under an experimental policy; source and transformation proof certificates missing.
Stronger self-declared policies rejected; protected independently checked policy admission not implemented.

release_gates.criterion: Complete semantic/primitive inventory and reproducible baseline.
release_gates.reason: File inventory exists; per-entrypoint semantic/assumption closure and complete strict legacy regression still required.

release_gates.criterion: Reviewed contracts, canonical vectors, independent readers and rejection fixtures.
release_gates.reason: Integer contract/core implemented; comprehensive refinement, general pass planning and profile/extension admission unfinished.

release_gates.criterion: Declared baseline extracts through KIR without mandatory CUDA or Karamel.
release_gates.reason: No actual checked Kuiper/Pulse source export to executable KIR.

release_gates.criterion: Real-GPU SPIR-T/Vulkan path with correct results, errors and CUDA-free dependencies.
release_gates.reason: Frontend-free integer path tested; real exported Kuiper kernel and its proof binding missing.

release_gates.criterion: Required memory, ownership, subgroup, atomic and async relations checked on qualified devices.
release_gates.reason: Synchronous integer ownership implemented; broader memory events, convergence, async faults and cancellation not qualified.

release_gates.criterion: All legacy inventory rows classified; all claimed features qualified for the release profile.
release_gates.reason: Floating point, barriers, workgroup/subgroup memory, general calls/pointers, reductions and matrices unsupported.

release_gates.criterion: Fixed evidence policy satisfied; O1-O10 dispositions and required relations complete; no ad hoc trust waivers.
release_gates.reason: O1–O10 and prefix/progress implementation proofs remain open; ABI lemmas only prove model facts.

release_gates.criterion: Independent compiler-only substitution with unchanged runtime/bindings passes against the exact immutable candidate without existing source/build/registry edits.
release_gates.reason: One real compiler and generic-routing tests; second independent compiler/admission qualification missing.

release_gates.criterion: Independent shared-artifact runtime substitution AND distinct real API backend pass against the exact immutable candidate without existing source/build/registry edits.
release_gates.reason: One real Vulkan runtime; second independently qualified runtime/candidate evidence missing.

release_gates.criterion: Independent frontend and host binding reuse unchanged contracts, compiler and runtime.
release_gates.reason: Core and C host interfaces tested; independent source frontend/binding qualification missing.

release_gates.criterion: Semantic extension installs additively and fails safely when its required support is absent.
release_gates.reason: Closed integer opcode/profile catalogue; semantic operation extension not implemented.

release_gates.criterion: Exact-candidate hardware/workload/operational/install/rollback matrix passes; safety and required soak have no waivers; performance follows fixed pass/fail/inconclusive policy.
Default new path builds, installs and runs without CUDA toolkit/runtime, NVCC or mandatory Karamel.
release_gates.reason: Portable Rust/KIR path builds without CUDA; source frontend path remains incomplete.

release_gates.criterion: Measured one-driver comparison supports an explicit promote/defer decision.
release_gates.reason: CPU Vulkan tests do not supply the required one-driver performance comparison.

release_gates.criterion: Annotation, loop-triage/exclusion, QPtr eligibility and dependency decisions supported by pinned probes before enabling affected paths.
release_gates.reason: Direct logical integer construction tested; complete prescribed feasibility matrix missing.

release_gates.criterion: Every mandatory baseline entrypoint and reachable semantic dependency has qualified CUDA-independent coverage and required evidence; deferred or CUDA-only rows block completion.
release_gates.reason: Legacy scope is not covered by the limited integer source-free path.

release_gates.criterion: If native host-plan compilation is enabled, establish interpreter/compiler equivalence including callbacks, failures, cleanup and asynchronous ownership.
release_gates.reason: Native host-plan code generation is not enabled or implemented.

evidence_rule: Add only reports produced by successful real runs. Each report identifies its own sources, binary/tool identities and limited scope.
